current.service_desc: 9line tells agencies which vulnerabilities in their software and AI supply chain actually affect them, with evidence an assessor can re-check. A customer submits a repository or container image through the web application or API. 9line generates a CycloneDX SBOM, inventories the AI models and agents it contains, matches components against vulnerability data, and determines whether each vulnerable code path is reachable using a deterministic call-graph engine. It returns a VEX document in which every statement carries its evidence. An in-boundary model (Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud) explains verdicts but cannot clear a finding.
